meta.title: deep-layer attention pruning for visual grounding

units.text: The computational cost of vision-language models scales quadratically with the number of visual tokens, motivating extensive research on token reduction strategies.

units.text: Prior work has identified that attention-based pruning can fail catastrophically on spatially-sensitive tasks like visual grounding, even when it succeeds on coarse-grained VQA [cite] .

units.text: We evaluate on InternVL2.5-8B [cite] , a state-of-the-art vision-language model with 32 LLM layers (InternLM2 backbone) and 256 visual tokens per image tile.

units.text: We evaluate on the RefCOCO family of visual grounding benchmarks [cite] : RefCOCO, RefCOCO+, and RefCOCOg.
